Tooltip_item_Bullbar:
Can be installed to protect the front of the vehicle
Protects: [Headlights, Hood & Engine]
Tooltip_item_HoodArmour:
Can be installed to protect the engine bay
Protects: [Hood & Engine]
Tooltip_item_WindshieldArmour:
Can be installed to protect a vehicle windshield
Compatible: (Front or Rear)
Tooltip_item_DoorArmour:
Can be installed to protect a vehicle door
Compatible: (Left or Right, Front, Middle or Rear)
Tooltip_item_WindowArmour:
Can be installed to protect a vehicle window
Compatible: (Left or Right, Front, Middle or Rear)
Does not (Currently) prevent injury through open window
Tooltip_item_TrunkArmour:
Can be installed to protect the trunk of a vehicle
Protects: [Trunk Lid & Trunk / TruckBed]
Tooltip_item_TruckBedCover:
Can be installed on the truck beds of compatible vehicles to expand the storage capacity of the vehicle
(Better tiers have bigger capacity)
Tooltip_item_RoofRack:
Can be installed on the roof of compatible vehicles to expand the storage capacity of the vehicle
(Better tiers have bigger capacity)
Tooltip_item_TireChain:
Can be installed to protect a vehicle wheel
Compatible: (Left or Right, Front or Rear)
Tooltip_item_TrailerArmour:
Can be installed on the frame of compatible trailers to protect them from damage
Protects: [TrunkLid & Trailer Trunk]
Tooltip_item_DEBUG: This is a DEBUG item, if you are seeing this then something is probably broken
